definitions.gloss: an introductory chapter or book that lays out the groundwork of a subject — used especially in academic titles and in the openings of scholarly works
definitions.explanation: Found most often in book titles in the humanities, sciences, and philosophy — e.g., 「{哲学|てつがく}{序説|じょせつ}」 ("An Introduction to Philosophy"). More formal and more scholarly than {入門|にゅうもん} or {概論|がいろん}, and typically emphasizes foundational concepts or preliminary arguments that prepare the reader for fuller treatment.

examples.japanese: 「⟦{経済|けいざい}{学|がく}→経済学：19376_keizaigaku⟧{序説|じょせつ}」⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んだ→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{本|ほん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{言語学|げんごがく}→言語学：22422_gengogaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{序説|じょせつ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧{定評|ていひょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This book has an established reputation as an introduction to linguistics.

examples.japanese: {序説|じょせつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{著者|ちょしゃ}→著者：03501_chosha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{目的|もくてき}→目的：02433_mokuteki⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{明|あき}らかにしている→明らかにする：22256_akirakanisuru⟧。
examples.english: In the introduction, the author sets out the aims and methods of the study.

examples.japanese: カント⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{書|しょ}いた「⟦{将来|しょうらい}→将来：01438_shourai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{形而上学|けいじじょうがく}⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{序説|じょせつ}」⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{哲学|てつがく}→哲学：03548_tetsugaku⟧⟦{史|し}→〜史：28471_shi⟧⟦における→〜における：21802_niokeru⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧な⟦{著作|ちょさく}→著作：18234_chosaku⟧⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧。
examples.english: Kant's "Prolegomena to Any Future Metaphysics" is an important work in the history of philosophy.

notes:
Composed of {序|じょ} ("order, preface, introductory") + ⟦{説|せつ}→説：00360_setsu⟧ ("theory, discourse"). Literally "introductory discourse," close to the Latin term "prolegomena" in scholarly usage.

USAGE:
- Most commonly appears in book titles and chapter titles of academic works: X⟦{学|がく}→〜学：09846_gaku⟧{序説|じょせつ} or 「X⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{序説|じょせつ}」.
- Signals a formal, scholarly register — not suitable for casual writing or everyday introductions.
- Can also refer to the introductory chapter of a book or treatise that lays out its scope, questions, and methods.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{哲学|てつがく}→哲学：03548_tetsugaku⟧{序説|じょせつ}: an introduction to philosophy
- X⟦{学|がく}→〜学：09846_gaku⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{序説|じょせつ}: a prolegomenon to (field) X
- {序説|じょせつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write an introductory treatise
- {序説|じょせつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{当|あ}たる→当たる：01860_ataru⟧⟦{章|しょう}→章：03768_shou⟧: the chapter that serves as the introduction

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{入門|にゅうもん}→入門：11643_nyuumon⟧: introduction, primer — aimed at beginners; much more accessible in tone.
- ⟦{概論|がいろん}→概論：04126_gairon⟧: general survey — overview of a field, less foundational than {序説|じょせつ}.
- ⟦{序論|じょろん}→序論：23169_joron⟧: introductory chapter/argument — often the first chapter of an academic paper or thesis.
- ⟦{序文|じょぶん}→序文：06205_jobun⟧: preface — the opening remarks of a book, often by the author or editor.
- ⟦{前書|まえが}き→前書き：17127_maegaki⟧: foreword — a short prefatory note, usually more personal or practical.
